summary: argenx SE filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a September 29, 2026 press release announcing new clinical, long-term and real-world data presentations for VYVGART in myasthenia gravis and CIDP, plus pipeline results for empasiprubart and adimanebart, at the 2026 AANEM Annual Meeting and MGFA Scientific Session held September 29-October 2, 2026, in Orlando, Florida. The filing discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. No special-situation event is present; this is ordinary medical-conference data disclosure, and the risk-arb angle is nil.
